channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: FANTASTIC FOUR #11 Will Finally Introduce A New Version Of The Future Foundation This May
item.description: This May, Fantastic Four #11 by Ryan North and Patrick Boutin, an epilogue to the current "Invincible Woman" arc, marks the long-awaited comic book return of the Future Foundation.

item.title: WONDER MAN TV Spot Heaps Praise On MCU TV Series; Showrunner Talks Possible Season 2 Plans
item.description: A newly released Wonder Man TV spot finds a unique way to highlight the show's glowing reviews. We also have comments from showrunner Andrew Guest on a possible second season.

item.title: Chris Pratt Opens On James Gunn's MCU Firing And What Landed Him Star-Lord Role In GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
item.description: Mercy star Chris Pratt has revealed what sold James Gunn on his portrayal of Star-Lord in Guardians of the Galaxy and opens up on Disney's decision to fire the filmmaker.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Wild Opening Scene Revealed; Details On MCU's Take On Doctor Doom - SPOILERS
item.description: New Avengers: Doomsday rumours claim to reveal the movie's jaw-dropping opening scene. We also have a couple of minor updates about Robert Downey Jr.'s portrayal of Doctor Doom.

item.title: THE SUPER MARIO GALAXY MOVIE New Trailer Sees Mario And Luigi Finally Teaming Up With Yoshi
item.description: Nintendo has shared a new trailer and poster for The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, finally revealing Illumination's take on the fan-favourite dinosaur Yoshi, who first appeared in 1990's Super Mario World.

item.title: THOR: RAGNAROK Director Taika Waititi Explains Why His Comedic Take On Thor "Was For The Greater Good"
item.description: Following the mixed response to 2022's Thor: Love and Thunder, filmmaker Taika Waititi has explained why taking the Odinson down a comedic route was essential for 2017's Thor: Ragnarok.

item.title: A New Era For DRAGON BALL: SUPER Sequel Anime Series Confirmed As Goku And Vegeta Join THE GALACTIC PATROL
item.description: After years of uncertainty, the Dragon Ball Super TV anime has officially confirmed its long-awaited return. Read on for the full details.

item.title: AVENGERS: SECRET WARS Rumor Reveals Why Marvel Is Delaying Decision To Split Movie
item.description: A big Avengers: Secret Wars rumour reveals when Marvel Studios will likely make a decision about splitting the movie in two, while we also have news on that Scarlet Witch project.

item.title: ZOOTOPIA 2 Tops AVENGERS: ENDGAME To Become China's Biggest U.S. Movie; MERCY And RETURN TO SILENT HILL Flop
item.description: While there was good news for Zootopia 2 this weekend, movies like Mercy, Return to Silent Hill, and 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple are all struggling massively at the box office.

item.title: WONDER MAN: An Updated Ranking Of Every Live-Action MCU TV Series According To Rotten Tomatoes
item.description: With Wonder Man just a couple of days away from debuting on Disney+, we're sharing an updated ranking of every live-action MCU TV show, according to their Rotten Tomatoes scores.
